messages:
Anya Rao: Dropping a new iteration of the Playground chat UI for review. Main asks: streaming render (selectable partial text), stop/try-again affordance, token counter placement and behavior, and prompt library interactions while streaming. Figma: https://figma.redwood/example-playground-ux-v4 (mock-4)
Miguel Santos: Nice! One decision: should token count tick in realtime (per chunk) or snapshot after generation ends? Realtime is useful but can be noisy.
Anya Rao: Leaning realtime but extremely low visual priority. Tiny, muted, no layout shift.
Shilpa Patel: Accessibility checklist: 1) stop/try-again buttons must be in tab order and announce state; 2) streaming area needs an aria role that doesn't cause screen reader jumps; 3) ensure keyboard-only users can interrupt.
Dave Kim: Microcopy tweak: primary action = "Stop"; secondary = "Try again" (less jargon-y than "Regenerate"). Also add a tooltip: "Stop generation (partial result saved)".
Olivia Chen: For SR users consider adding an offscreen hint: "Stop generation; partial output remains selectable." Also make sure the stop action is reachable via a single-space shortcut (e.g., press Esc) and documented in the tooltip.
Evan Brooks: UX thought: when streaming we should allow selecting partial content. Avoid full-screen loaders or overlays that intercept pointer events.
Anya Rao: Good call. Also: if a user clicks a prompt suggestion from the prompt library while streaming, do we interrupt or queue? Proposal: show a small confirm bottom-sheet: "Replace current prompt and run? This will stop current generation." Buttons: Replace & Run / Queue / Cancel.
Miguel Santos: Could we simplify to two choices: Replace & Run / Queue? Cancel is implicit via escape. But explicit cancel may reduce mistakes.
Shilpa Patel: If we show a dialog make it keyboard focused and labeled with role="alertdialog". Also announce: "This will stop current generation" when it appears.
ui-bot: Uploaded prototype with confirm flow and token overlay to staging: https://staging.redwood/playground/v4-proto
Dave Kim: Token counter placement options tested: A) bottom-right overlay (floats above stream), B) inline near input. I prefer overlay to keep input stable. Overlay must not steal pointer events.
Olivia Chen: Design constraints for overlay: 11px semibold, 8px vertical padding, background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6) with 6px radius, and provide a visible focus ring when keyboard-focused. Also add title attribute: "Tokens used (est.)"
Anya Rao: UX for interactions: clicking a suggestion during streaming triggers the confirm sheet; "Queue" appends to a small per-chat queue indicator and does not stop the current generation. Queue icon shows up near the prompt library.
Miguel Santos: Suggest a tiny toast when replacing: "This will stop current generation" that disappears after 3s and includes Undo. That reduces accidental replacements.
Shilpa Patel: Toast must be reachable and announced — role="status" with a visible keyboard-focusable "Undo" link.
Evan Brooks: Visual detail: add a faint animated caret/shimmer at the trailing edge of the streamed text to indicate 'live' writing. Keep motion subtle and provide a user preference to disable animations.
Dave Kim: Also ensure copy is consistent: 'Try again' everywhere instead of 'Regenerate'. I'll patch Figma.
ui-bot: Deployed styling changes (token overlay + shimmer opt-in) to staging branch. Preview: https://staging.redwood/playground/v4-preview
Anya Rao: Action items: Shilpa -> a11y test different aria roles and announce wording; Miguel -> prototype overlay token counter with no-pointer behavior; Olivia -> keyboard-only flows and confirm sheet interactions; Dave -> add shimmer variant + motion toggle; Evan -> queue UI microcopy. We'll reconvene in ~24 hours for results. :thumbsup:
